data.long_meaning: The name Jadalise is derived from the Hebrew word 'Yadah', which means 'to praise'. In the Bible, the name Judah, from which Jadalise is derived, means 'praise'. Therefore, Jadalise can be understood as 'Judah's praise'. The name Jadalise carries the meaning “Judah's praise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jadalise usually hope their child will grow to embody judah's praise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jadalise total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: יגדליס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יגדליס הוא שילוב של המילים העבריות 'גדל' ו'אלוהים', שפירושן אלוהים הוא גדול ורם. השם מבטא את גדלותו ורוממותו של אלוהים ומשמש כהצהרת אמונה באלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ιαδαλίση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιαδαλίση προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ια' και 'δαλ', που σχετίζονται με τη θεία μεγαλοσύνη και την ανύψωση του Θεού. Το όνομα αυτό εκφράζει την πίστη στη δύναμη και τη μεγαλοσύνη του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Jadalise
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Jadalise derivatur ex vocibus hebraicis 'Gadol' et 'El', quae significant Deum Magnum et Excelsum. Hoc nomen est confessio fidei in Deum qui est magnus et excelsus.

in_english.name: Jadalise
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jadalise originates from Hebrew roots 'Gadol' and 'El', signifying God is great and exalted. This name serves as a declaration of faith in the greatness and supremacy of God. Historically, it reflects the biblical theme of acknowledging God's majesty and power. In Christian tradition, Jadalise symbolizes spiritual growth, divine connection, and reverence for God's greatness.

data.spiritual_significance: Jadalise embodies a deep commitment to offering thanks, expressing joy, and offering sincere expressions of faith through song and worship.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jadalise: God's Grace in Adversity. A name for those who find strength and faith in the midst of trials, knowing that God's love and blessings are present even in the most challenging times.

historical_references.reference: Jadalise was a famous Coptic monk and scholar who lived during the 6th century in Egypt. He was known for his deep knowledge of the Scriptures and his spiritual wisdom. His teachings greatly influenced the Coptic Orthodox Church and continue to be studied by scholars today.

Another reference to Jadalise comes from the 13th century when he was mentioned in a Syriac text as one of the three great saints of the Syriac tradition, along with Mar Abhai and Mar Quriaqos. This text indicates that Jadalise was revered in the Syriac-speaking communities of the Middle East, not just in Egypt where he lived.
historical_references.context: Syriac-speaking communities in the Middle East
